quarterly_data.quarter: Doosan Enerbility press release: Doosan Enerbility's Newly Developed Gas Turbine Shipped Out (10-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer SpaceXAI: Doosan Enerbility completed the manufacturing of its newly developed 380MW gas turbine (Model DGT6-300H S2) for the U.S. company SpaceXAI and held a shipment ceremony at its gas turbine assembly shop in Changwon with SpaceXAI project leadership attending; the release says the shipment marks the company's entry into the U.S. power and AI infrastructure market and that the turbine will be deployed as part of SpaceXAI's expanding infrastructure investments in the United States. The two companies also discussed future collaboration. Seungwoo Sohn, CEO of the Power Services Business Group: 'This shipment proves that the quality and technology of our homegrown gas turbines are recognized in the global AI supply chain... We will now accelerate our expansion into North America and the wider global gas turbine market.'
quarterly_data.figure: 380MW gas turbine (Model DGT6-300H S2) shipped; contract value not stated
